question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**slowly**" is appropriate because it indicates the gradual movement of the orange, which matches the gradual disappearance of the ship.
 
• "Passionately" is incorrect as it denotes strong emotions, which are not relevant here.
 
• "Accidentally" is not suitable because it suggests an unintended action.
 
• "Reluctantly" is incorrect as it implies unwillingness, which does not fit the context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Stick a pin most of the way into an orange, and slowly__ turn the orange away from you. You will see the pin disappear, as a ship does on the earth.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Passionately (जोशीले)**: indicating strong feelings or intense enthusiasm.
 
• **Accidentally (संयोगवश)**: happening by chance or inadvertently.
 
• **Reluctantly (अनिच्छा)**: unwillingly or with hesitation.
 
• **Slowly (धीरे-धीरे)**: at a slow speed; not quickly.
